io.name: clk
io.description: Clock; all state updates on posedge.

io.name: predict_valid
io.description: Request a branch prediction for predict_pc.

io.name: train_mispredicted
io.description: Training branch was mispredicted; recover history.

io.name: train_history
io.description: Branch history register value used for the trained branch.

io.name: predict_history
io.description: Branch history register value used for the prediction.

functional_summary.overview: Gshare branch predictor with 7-bit PC and 7-bit global history XOR-hashed into a 7-bit index addressing a 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters. A 7-bit global branch history register is maintained. Prediction and training interfaces operate independently; training takes precedence over prediction for history-register updates in the same cycle.
rules: Reset (asynchronous, active-high): clears the 7-bit global history register and all 128 two-bit saturating counters to 0 (strongly not-taken).

Prediction: when predict_valid=1, compute index = predict_pc XOR global_history (7 bits). Output predict_taken from the 2-bit counter at that index (MSB of counter: 1=taken, 0=not-taken) and output predict_history = current global_history. These outputs reflect state before any same-cycle training update.
Prediction history update: at the next posedge, if predict_valid=1 and no training history update occurs, shift global_history left by 1 and insert the predicted direction into the LSB.

Training PHT update: when train_valid=1, compute index = train_pc XOR train_history. At the next posedge, update the 2-bit saturating counter at that index toward train_taken (increment if taken and not 3, decrement if not-taken and not 0).
Training history recovery: when train_valid=1 and train_mispredicted=1, at the next posedge set global_history = {train_history[5:0], train_taken} (state immediately after the mispredicting branch).

Same-cycle conflict: if train_valid=1 and train_mispredicted=1 and predict_valid=1 in the same cycle, training history recovery takes precedence over the prediction history shift; the prediction outputs still reflect pre-update PHT and history state.
Same-cycle PHT access: if prediction and training target the same PHT entry in the same cycle, the prediction reads the pre-update counter value; the training write is applied at the next posedge.
Outputs predict_taken and predict_history are combinational functions of current state and inputs (latency 0).
